Sizing the AC: With central AC system installations, it’s all about finding the perfectly sized system for your home. Too small won’t be enough to cool the home properly, and too big will cause the AC to malfunction. In either scenario, it’s going to severely hamper your AC’s efficiency.
Efficiency Ratings: Not all air conditioners are created equally. Their efficiency ratings will vary, and that largely depends on how much you’re willing to spend. Of course, overall efficiency isn’t just dependent on the unit, so it’s still possible to be efficient and budget-friendly.
Features: You’ll want to consider features before early on in the buying process. For example, a ductless AC installation will allow you to do many things you can’t with your typical central AC system, such as individual room control.

A clean machine operates more efficiently so you can save on your electric bill and, more importantly, improve your indoor air quality.
